name: MoralSim
description: MoralSim is a simulation-based benchmark evaluating whether LLMs behave morally when ethical imperatives directly conflict with rewards or incentives. It uses game-theoretic social dilemmas (Prisoner's Dilemma and Public Goods Game) under multiple moral framings and survival conditions to test ethical alignment in agentic decision-making.
reputation: From ETH Zurich, CMU, Max Planck, University of Michigan; addresses important gap in agentic safety evaluation
notes: GPT-4o-mini highest morality (76.3%), Qwen-3-235B lowest (7.9%); reasoning models do NOT perform better on moral behavior; 32 base experimental configurations x 5 seeds x 9 models; cost ~$230 total.
